item.question: What are co-risk measures and how do they improve upon traditional risk assessments?
item.answer: Co-risk measures, such as Conditional Value-at-Risk (CoVaR) and Conditional Expected Shortfall (CoES), assess the impact of systemic stress on specific assets or portfolios by considering their interactions with other entities. These measures provide a more comprehensive evaluation of systemic risks by accounting for conditional dependencies between different parts of the financial system.
